_comment: Static manifest of the Notify Me! MCP server tools, copied from the published API docs (info.description of https://api.notify-me.app/v1/schema/). The live tools/list requires an API key, so registries and crawlers cannot see it; this file is what they can index. Keep in sync with the server.
auth: Authorization: Bearer <Notify Me! API key with the mcp entitlement>

tools.name: get_shop_overview
tools.description: Non-PII shop snapshot: plan, suspension status, currency, locale, trial / migration / customer-accounts state.

tools.name: get_bis_settings
tools.description: Back in Stock settings: service active flag and product selection mode.

tools.name: get_preorder_settings
tools.description: Pre-Order settings: service active, selling-plan group creation, mixed-cart alert.

tools.name: get_wishlist_settings
tools.description: Wishlist settings: service active, guest mode, share state, enabled share channels.

tools.name: get_low_stock_settings
tools.description: Low Stock settings: whether the service is active.

tools.name: get_demand_summary
tools.description: Top unfilled Back in Stock demand by product / variant with request counts and estimated revenue.

tools.name: get_bis_performance
tools.description: Aggregate BIS performance: requests, notifications sent, products in demand, recovered revenue, growth rates.

tools.name: get_preorder_analytics
tools.description: Aggregate Pre-Order analytics: revenue, pre-ordered variant count, notifications sent, growth rates.

tools.name: get_wishlist_insights
tools.description: Aggregate Wishlist insights: product count, list count, attributed order revenue, growth rates.

tools.name: get_low_stock_status
tools.description: Low Stock notification status: alerts enabled, inventory threshold, send policy.

tools.name: get_bis_widget_appearance
tools.description: Back in Stock widget visibility and colors (product / collection / home).

tools.name: get_wishlist_widget_appearance
tools.description: Wishlist widget visibility and colors (product / collection / landing / access button).

tools.name: get_low_stock_widget_appearance
tools.description: Low Stock widget visibility and colors.

tools.name: get_preorder_widget_appearance
tools.description: Pre-Order widget visibility and colors (product / collection / landing / cart).
